summary: Nike kit (white/black/gold). École Noir&Blanc (SCO Fonds de Dotation) front centre with the l'atoll chest roundel and the Ville d'Angers collar mark; Système U on the shorts; Ligue 1 McDonald's patch and 1TEAM mark on the sleeve; no back sponsor. Viwone, Sorare and Groupe Actual are official partners without a shirt placement.
